name: CE_INDEX_BANK_BRANCHES
description: This table contains bank branch information.

columns.name: BRANCH_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bank branch.

columns.name: BANK_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a bank party.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank branch.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_NAME_ALT
columns.description: Alternate name of the bank branch.

columns.name: BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Numerical value assigned to the bank branch.

columns.name: BRANCH_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Numerical value assigned to the bank branch party.

columns.name: HOME_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country of the bank branch.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: First date that the bank branch is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last date that the bank branch is active.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_TYPE
columns.description: The type of banking institution to which the branch belongs. The valid values are ABA, CHIPS, Other, SWIFT.

columns.name: EFT_SWIFT_CODE
columns.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) used by SWIFT to identify a bank or a bank branch. The BIC is a universal method of identifying financial institutions to facilitate the automated processing of telecommunication messages in banking and related financial environments.

columns.name: EFT_USER_NUMBER
columns.description: Number used for identification and validation in electronic funds transfer.

columns.name: EDI_ID_NUMBER
columns.description: Number used by the bank in electronic data interchange.

columns.name: BANK_CODE
columns.description: Numerical value assigned to the bank.

columns.name: EDI_LOCATION
columns.description: Name of the location of the electronic data interchange for the bank.

columns.name: RFC_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Regional Finance Center (RFC).  RFC is considered a bank branch of the U.S. Treasury bank and is responsible for the disbursement of public monies on behalf of some federal agencies.

columns.name: BRANCH_INSTITUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Institution type of the bank branch. For example, bank branch and clearing house branch.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
